#1
किं|kim|kim — what, interrogative pronoun (nom./acc. sg. neut.)
तद्ब्रह्म|tat brahma|tad — that (tat: nom./acc. sg. neut.; -t + b- → -d b-, written joined);;brahman — brahman, kept untranslated (nom./acc. sg. neut., predicate)
किमध्यात्मं|kim adhyātmam|kim — what (nom./acc. sg. neut.);;adhi-ātman — adhyātma, 'pertaining to the self, the individual self' (technical term, defined below at verse 3 as one's own essential nature, svabhāva; nom./acc. sg. neut., predicate; final -m stays before the vowel a-, written joined)
किं|kim|kim — what
कर्म|karma|karman — action (kept translated, not on the untranslated list; nom./acc. sg. neut., predicate)
पुरुषोत्तम|puruṣa-uttama|puruṣa — person (first compound member);;uttama — highest, supreme (puruṣa-uttama, 'highest of persons', rendered 'Supreme Person' wherever it occurs; here vocative sg., addressed to Kṛṣṇa; a + u → o. The compound has two senses, and the text does not say which Arjuna means: an honorific, 'best of men', of the kind the epic gives its heroes (Arjuna himself is puruṣarṣabha, 'bull among men', at 2.15), or the title Kṛṣṇa claims for himself at 15.18, the Person beyond the Perishable and the Imperishable. One rendering is kept so that the reader can see it is one word)
--
अधिभूतं|adhibhūtam|adhi-bhūta — adhibhūta, 'pertaining to material existence' (technical term, defined below at verse 4 as the perishable state, kṣaro bhāvaḥ; nom./acc. sg. neut., predicate)
च|ca|ca — and
किं|kim|kim — what
प्रोक्तमधिदैवं|proktam adhidaivam|pra-vac — to declare, call (prokta: past participle 'called, declared', nom./acc. sg. neut.; final -m stays before the vowel a-, written joined)
किमुच्यते|kim ucyate|kim — what (nom./acc. sg. neut.);;vac — to speak (ucyate: present passive 3rd sg. 'is said, is called'; final -m stays before the vowel u-, written joined)
#2
अधियज्ञः|adhiyajñaḥ|adhi-yajña — adhiyajña, 'pertaining to sacrifice, the lord of sacrifice' (technical term, defined below at verse 4 as identical with Kṛṣṇa himself; nom. sg., subject)
कथं|katham|katham — how (interrogative adverb)
कोऽत्र|kaḥ atra|kim — who (kaḥ: nom. sg. masc.; -aḥ + a- → -o with avagraha);;atra — here (adverb)
देहेऽस्मिन्मधुसूदन|dehe asmin madhusūdana|deha — body (dehe: loc. sg.; -e + a- → -e with avagraha);;idam — this (asmin: loc. sg. masc. 'in this');;Madhusūdana — 'slayer of [the demon] Madhu', an epithet of Kṛṣṇa (vocative; written joined, n + m- unchanged)
--
प्रयाणकाले|prayāṇa-kāle|prayāṇa — departure, setting forth (from the body, i.e. death) (first compound member);;kāla — time (prayāṇa-kāla: 'the time of departure', loc. sg.)
च|ca|ca — and
कथं|katham|katham — how
ज्ञेयोऽसि|jñeyaḥ asi|jñā — to know (jñeya: gerundive 'to be known', nom. sg. masc., predicate; -aḥ + a- → -o with avagraha);;as — to be (asi: present 2nd sg. 'you are')
नियतात्मभिः|niyata-ātmabhiḥ|ni-yam — to restrain, control (niyata: past participle 'controlled, disciplined', first compound member);;ātman — self (niyata-ātman: 'of controlled self', instr. pl. 'by those of disciplined mind'; a + ā → ā)
#3
अक्षरं|akṣaram|akṣara — the imperishable (a name for brahman, opposite of kṣara 'the perishable', verse 4; also 'syllable', a distinct sense used at verse 13; nom. sg. neut., predicate)
ब्रह्म|brahma|brahman — brahman, kept untranslated (nom. sg. neut., subject)
परमं|paramam|parama — highest, supreme (nom. sg. neut., agreeing with akṣaram)
स्वभावोऽध्यात्ममुच्यते|svabhāvaḥ adhyātmam ucyate|sva-bhāva — one's own nature, essential being (svabhāva: nom. sg., subject; -aḥ + a- → -o with avagraha);;adhi-ātman — adhyātma (nom./acc. sg. neut., predicate);;vac — to speak (ucyate: present passive 3rd sg. 'is called'; final -m stays before the vowel u-, written joined)
--
भूतभावोद्भवकरो|bhūta-bhāva-udbhava-karaḥ|bhūta — being, creature (first compound member);;bhāva — existence, state of being (second member; bhūta + bhāva: a + b- stays, no change);;ud-bhava — coming forth, arising (third member; bhāva + udbhava: a + u → o);;kara — that which makes, causes (agent noun from √kṛ; bhūta-bhāva-udbhava-kara: 'that which causes the coming-into-existence of beings', nom. sg., predicate; -aḥ before v- → -o)
विसर्गः|visargaḥ|vi-sṛj — to emit, send forth (visarga: 'emission, creative discharge', nom. sg., subject)
कर्मसंज्ञितः|karma-saṃjñitaḥ|karman — action, kept translated (first compound member);;sam-jñā — to name, call (saṃjñita: past participle 'named, called', karma-saṃjñita: 'called action', nom. sg., predicate)
#4
अधिभूतं|adhibhūtam|adhi-bhūta — adhibhūta (nom. sg. neut., predicate, cf. verse 1)
क्षरो|kṣaraḥ|kṣara — the perishable, perishable (opposite of akṣara, verse 3; nom. sg., predicate; -aḥ before bh- → -o)
भावः|bhāvaḥ|bhāva — state, existence (nom. sg., subject: 'the perishable state')
पुरुषश्चाधिदैवतम्|puruṣaḥ ca adhidaivatam|puruṣa — the Person (nom. sg., subject; -aḥ + c- → -aś c-);;ca — and;;adhi-daivata — adhidaivata, a variant form of adhidaiva, 'pertaining to the gods, the divine order' (nom. sg. neut., predicate; ca + a- → cā-)
--
अधियज्ञोऽहमेवात्र|adhiyajñaḥ aham eva atra|adhi-yajña — adhiyajña (nom. sg., predicate; -aḥ + a- → -o with avagraha);;aham — I (nom. sg., subject; written joined before eva, no change);;eva — indeed, precisely;;atra — here (eva + atra: a + a → ā)
देहे|dehe|deha — body (loc. sg., 'in the body')
देहभृतां|deha-bhṛtām|deha — body (first compound member);;bhṛt — bearer, one who bears (deha-bhṛt: 'body-bearer, embodied being', gen. pl.)
वर|vara|vara — best, most excellent (vocative, addressed to Arjuna)
#5
अन्तकाले|anta-kāle|anta — end (first compound member);;kāla — time (anta-kāla: 'the time of the end', loc. sg.)
च|ca|ca — and
मामेव|mām eva|aham — I (mām: acc. sg. 'me');;eva — alone, indeed (written joined, no change)
स्मरन्मुक्त्वा|smaran muktvā|smṛ — to remember (smaran: present participle 'remembering', nom. sg.; written joined before m-, no change);;muc — to release, let go (muktvā: gerund 'having released, having given up')
कलेवरम्|kalevaram|kalevara — the body (acc. sg., object of muktvā)
--
यः|yaḥ|yad — who (nom. sg. masc. relative)
प्रयाति|prayāti|pra-yā — to go forth, depart (present 3rd sg.)
स|saḥ|tad — he (saḥ: nom. sg. masc.; the pronoun saḥ/eṣaḥ drops its visarga before any consonant, never taking -o)
मद्भावं|mad-bhāvam|mad — me (stem form, first compound member);;bhāva — state, existence (mad-bhāva: 'my state of being', acc. sg., object of yāti)
याति|yāti|yā — to go, attain (present 3rd sg.)
नास्त्यत्र|na asti atra|na — not (na + a- → nā-);;as — to be, exist (asti: present 3rd sg.; -i + a- → -y a-);;atra — here, in this (adverb)
संशयः|saṃśayaḥ|saṃ-śī — to doubt (saṃśaya: 'doubt', nom. sg., subject)
#6
यं|yam|yad — which (acc. sg. masc. relative, doubled for distribution: 'whatever')
यं|yam|yad — which (repeated)
वापि|vā api|vā — or;;api — even (vā + api: ā + a → ā)
स्मरन्भावं|smaran bhāvam|smṛ — to remember (smaran: present participle, nom. sg.; written joined before bh-, no change);;bhāva — state, existence (acc. sg., object of smaran)
त्यजत्यन्ते|tyajati ante|tyaj — to abandon, leave (tyajati: present 3rd sg.; -i + a- → -y a-);;anta — end (ante: loc. sg. 'at the end')
कलेवरम्|kalevaram|kalevara — the body (acc. sg., object of tyajati)
--
तं|tam|tad — that (acc. sg. masc., doubled for distribution)
तमेवैति|tam eva eti|tad — that (tam: repeated, written joined);;eva — precisely, that very (eva + eti: a + e → ai);;i — to go (eti: present 3rd sg. 'goes, attains')
कौन्तेय|kaunteya|Kaunteya — 'son of Kuntī', Arjuna (vocative)
सदा|sadā|sadā — always
तद्भावभावितः|tad-bhāva-bhāvitaḥ|tad — that (first compound member);;bhāva — state, existence (second member);;bhū — to be, become (bhāvita: causative past participle 'made to be, suffused, habituated', tad-bhāva-bhāvita: 'habituated to that state', nom. sg.)
#7
तस्मात्सर्वेषु|tasmāt sarveṣu|tad — that, therefore (tasmāt: abl. sg. neut. adverbial, 'therefore'; written joined before s-, no change);;sarva — all (sarveṣu: loc. pl.)
कालेषु|kāleṣu|kāla — time (loc. pl., 'at all times')
मामनुस्मर|mām anusmara|aham — I (mām: acc. sg. 'me');;anu-smṛ — to remember, keep in mind (anusmara: imperative 2nd sg. 'remember!'; written joined before a-, no change)
युध्य|yudhya|yudh — to fight (yudhya: imperative 2nd sg. 'fight!')
च|ca|ca — and
--
मय्यर्पितमनोबुद्धिर्मामेवैष्यस्यसंशयम्|mayi arpita-manaḥ-buddhiḥ mām eva eṣyasi asaṃśayam|aham — I (mayi: loc. sg. 'in me'; mayi + a- → mayy a-);;ā-ṛ — to fix, place upon (causative arpayati; arpita: causative past participle 'offered, fixed, placed upon', first compound member);;manas — mind (second member; manaḥ + buddhiḥ: -aḥ + b- → -o);;buddhi — intellect (arpita-manaḥ-buddhi: 'one whose mind and intellect are fixed [on me]', nom. sg.; -iḥ + m- → -ir m-);;aham — I (mām: acc. sg. 'me', written joined before eva);;eva — indeed, precisely;;i — to go (eṣyasi: future 2nd sg. 'you shall go, you shall attain'; eva + eṣyasi: a + e → ai);;a-saṃśaya — without doubt, doubtlessly (asaṃśayam: adverbial acc. sg. neut. in the vulgate reading printed here; -i + a- → -y a-; the BORI critical edition reads instead the nominative asaṃśayaḥ, 'there is no doubt', a real vulgate/BORI variant)
#8
अभ्यासयोगयुक्तेन|abhyāsa-yoga-yuktena|abhyāsa — repeated practice, exercise (first compound member);;yoga — yoga, kept untranslated (second member);;yuj — to join, discipline (yukta: past participle, abhyāsa-yoga-yukta: 'disciplined by the yoga of [repeated] practice', instr. sg.)
चेतसा|cetasā|cetas — mind, consciousness (instr. sg., 'with the mind')
नान्यगामिना|na anya-gāminā|na — not (na + a- → nā-);;anya — other, elsewhere (first compound member);;gāmin — going (anya-gāmin negated by na: 'not going elsewhere', instr. sg. masc., agreeing with cetasā)
--

#9
कविं|kavim|kavi — the seer, poet, sage (acc. sg., object of anusmaret)
पुराणमनुशासितारमणोरणीयांसमनुस्मरेद्यः|purāṇam anuśāsitāram aṇoḥ aṇīyāṃsam anusmaret yaḥ|purāṇa — ancient, primeval (purāṇam: acc. sg., agreeing with kavim; written joined before a-, no change);;anu-śās — to rule, govern, instruct (anuśāsitṛ: agent noun 'ruler, governor', anuśāsitāram: acc. sg.; written joined before a-, no change);;aṇu — the atom, the minutely small (aṇoḥ: abl. sg. 'than the atom'; -oḥ + a- → -or);;aṇīyaṃs — smaller, more minute (comparative of aṇu; aṇīyāṃsam: acc. sg., agreeing with kavim, 'smaller than the atom, subtler than the subtle');;anu-smṛ — to remember, meditate upon (anusmaret: optative 3rd sg. 'should meditate on'; written joined before a-, no change);;yad — who (yaḥ: nom. sg. masc. relative; -t + y- → -d y-)
--
सर्वस्य|sarvasya|sarva — all (gen. sg., 'of all')

तमसः|tamasaḥ|tamas — darkness (abl. sg., 'than darkness')

#10
